note: Debuffs players put on enemies that the replay's enemy frames show: amp raises the damage the target takes or lowers the damage it deals, cooldown marks a big damage window, encounter marks a boss mechanic a player puts on an enemy (shown like a hostile debuff; player-sourced debuffs on enemies are otherwise never encounter). Every ID was checked against SPELL_AURA_APPLIED DEBUFF lines from players on boss units (Nek'zali, Sszorak, the Twin Fangs, Vashnik) in two real 12.1 raid logs; Atrophic Poison only appears in the second log.
